security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when the debug security control logic evaluates mdbgen and msdcfg.{SDEDBGALW,VSEDBGALW,USEDBGALW} against current privilege level in cycle N, but the actual Debug Mode entry (halt acknowledgement, trigger fire, abstract command execution) occurs in cycle N+K without re-checking privilege level or control states. If an interrupt, privilege-changing instruction, or CSR write to msdcfg occurs between validation and execution, the hardware enters Debug Mode at a privilege level or with debug access rights that differ from what was validated—violating the spec mandate that 'both the validation and execution of debug requests occur under the same privilege level and the same debug control states.'
security_spec.summary: TOCTOU race between debug request validation and execution: privilege level or msdcfg control fields can change between the check cycle and Debug Mode entry, allowing debug access at unauthorized privilege levels
